market_outlook.short_term: Volatile and risk-off. Iran escalation and bond selloff dominate. Expect oil-driven inflation fears to pressure equities, particularly rate-sensitive growth. Tech may find support on AI earnings but faces multiple compression. Gold and energy outperform. 10Y yield likely tests new highs. Yen remains a wildcard for global risk appetite.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but bifurcated. AI capex cycle (Anthropic IPO, Dell, TSM) supports tech leadership through 2027. Australian earnings inflection signals global cyclical recovery. Housing remains structurally challenged. M&A activity at record levels supports PE and financials. Key risk: if Iran conflict escalates, inflation re-acceleration forces Fed to pause or hike, compressing multiples broadly.
